title: Impactrakr Validation Rule (L3 spec)
description: Specification schema for every validation rule in the Impactrakr Validation Engine. L3 = ready for implementation + BV audit. Each rule must satisfy this contract.

id.description: Unique rule ID. Format: <PILLAR>-<2 digits>. P=PURE core, PG=PURE Gap, EU=EU adapter, RC=RecyClass gap.

title.description: Short rule title (≤ 100 chars). Verbatim from RULE_REGISTER.Rule Name when possible.

pillar.description: Which catalog this rule belongs to.

cluster.description: Functional cluster (used for filtering in HTML view).

severity.description: Mirrors enum RuleSeverity in schema.prisma. BLOCK halts the flow; FLAG flags for manual review.

conditions.description: Pre-conditions for the rule to fire (skip otherwise). Format: 'Model.field == value'. Empty array = always fires for the event.

participant_types.description: Participant types impacted. G=Generator, B=Bin Custodian, H=Hauler, P=Processor, R=Recycler, INT=Integrator, NGO_BENEF=NGO Beneficiary, BUYER=Credit Buyer.

regions.description: Where the rule applies. GLOBAL = anywhere; MALTA is a subset of EU.

purpose.description: 1-2 paragraph plain-language statement of what this rule protects and why it exists. Written so a non-engineer (Lino, Julia) understands.

logic_human.description: Plain-English description of the validation logic. Reads as: 'BLOCK if X; PASS otherwise'.

logic_pseudocode.description: TypeScript-like pseudo-code of evaluate(ctx). Gabriel adapts to real stack. Must reference real schema fields.

when.description: Optional condition for when this evidence is required.

evidence.description: Documents that sustain the rule. May be empty for pure-logic rules.

block_pt.description: Message shown to user on BLOCK (Portuguese).

block_en.description: Message shown to user on BLOCK (English).

flag_pt.description: Message on FLAG (Portuguese). Only required if severity is FLAG.

flag_en.description: Message on FLAG (English). Only required if severity is FLAG.

idempotent.description: Re-running with same input produces same result without side effects.

on_fail.description: What the system does when the rule fails. E.g. 'Write ValidationResult; halt MASSID_INGEST; surface block_pt/en to user; log to AuditLog.'

on_pass.description: What happens on pass. Usually 'Write ValidationResult(passed=true); silent to user; continue pipeline.'

revalidation.description: When (and if) the rule re-runs. E.g. 'Re-runs on every MASSID update; on dependency change; on operator manual re-trigger.'

retry_window.description: Optional. Time window in which the user can fix and re-submit before escalation.

escalation.description: Optional. What happens after retry_window expires. E.g. 'Escalate to Compliance review queue.'

expected.description: Expected result on failure: passed=false, message, field.

negative.description: 2-5 negative test cases covering distinct failure modes.

edge_cases.description: Known edge cases and how the rule handles them. E.g. 'Null kyc_status treated as incomplete.'

bv_controls.description: Bureau Veritas control IDs (from BV_CHECKLIST sheet) that audit this rule.

procedure.description: How the BV auditor verifies the rule (review evidence pack, check logs, etc.).

sample_size.description: BV sample size. E.g. '100% of rules', 'Sample 30 participants', 'Full scan'.

related.description: Cross-references to other rules or BV controls with overlap or dependency.

quote.description: Optional verbatim quote (≤ 15 words to respect copyright).

references.description: Normative references that sustain the rule.

methodology_quote.description: Optional. Verbatim quote (≤ 25 words) from the PURE methodology that is the direct origin of this rule.

manual_review.description: Whether the rule requires human review when triggered (true typically for FLAG severity).

source_type.description: Source attribution (from RULE_REGISTER.Source Type column when applicable).

disposition.description: Disposition for the rule (from RULE_REGISTER when applicable).

odoo_objects.description: Odoo objects involved (from RULE_REGISTER when applicable). Informational only.

last_reviewed.description: ISO date of last review by owner.

audit_findings.description: Audit findings IDs from audit-pure-methodology-consistency.md that affect this rule (e.g. ['B-04', 'E-01']).
